name: Ambajogai
assessment: Official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh and Mahabhumi sources evidence a state land-record/cadastral-map custodian and a Mahabhunakasha/Bhu-Naksha procedure that includes parcel maps. No anonymous Ambajogai parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Marathi first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. Official search pages were reachable through search indexing, while direct anonymous requests to the principal Maharashtra portals timed out or failed DNS. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Maximum retained full parcel polygons: 3; retained count: 0.
Exact WUP point was preserved; it was not moved to force a parcel hit.
A timeout, DNS failure, map extent miss, login wall, or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
No citywide completeness or open geometry coverage is asserted.

qualification.reason: No anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or Ambajogai coverage was qualified.

uncertainty: State-level cadastral procedure is real and first-party, but direct viewer access was unavailable in this attempt and no city-specific public vector route was evidenced.
doNotInfer: No exact-point query was completed, so no parcel hit/miss conclusion is valid.
State service existence is not proof of open Ambajogai geometry coverage.
Packet completion is not source integration or admission.
